In-game publication via 0x00725200 still requires GAME_SPECIFIC_INITIALIZATION (blocked factory field / 0x00686000). seam.rationale: Present/Clear on a host-owned device remain a legitimate post-init API boundary. Phase 21 still lacks a DEVICE↔renderer alias and a raw-device Draw path, so the seam is not CLEAN (CLEAN requires meaningful ordinary rendering beyond Present).

d3d9_implementation.reason: Device identity and Present/Clear consumers are established, but the Draw path is engine COM via 0x017AA798 without a proven DEVICE relationship. Implementing D3D9 would not yet advance a defensible first useful frame.
